lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Professor, is that... a rummage sale?

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Indeed it is! How fortuitous. I've been meaning to stop by.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Of course. One must always be prepared, Luke.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: But I thought we were just going to Grocery Outlet!

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: We are. But a rummage sale is an excellent opportunity to practice your shopping skills.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Practice?! This is way more intense than a regular store!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The rummage sale is indeed chaotic. People are everywhere, haggling, bargaining, and searching through piles of items.

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: Welcome, welcome! Everything must go! Name your price!

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: I'm looking for something very specific. A vintage radio, perhaps?

lines.speaker: clerk
lines.text: Radio? Radio... Ah! I have just the thing!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Professor, why do you need another radio?

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Patience, Luke. All will become clear in time.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I still don't understand what you need it for.

lines.speaker: layton
lines.text: Sometimes, Luke, we acquire things not for immediate use, but for future necessity.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: As they leave the rummage sale, something strange begins to happen...
